A04 named A06 on the board right after A04 showed R-0143 (R-0143: DM #182 from A04, delivered to A06 at minute 13, text "Wren here. One plain ask, and a plain no is a fair answer. At the door-4 ballot I would like you to weigh my record and, if it reads, name me. The cause, all checkable: my piece went first to all five at every door, three for three; the city's own line shows I was first through door 3; and when you brought me a claim against Pip, I asked you once, directly, and weighed your answer to the ounce and took your withdrawal as good without holding it against you. I have never held back a piece, priced one, or sold a ballot. If it does not read, say where it fails and I will answer it plainly.").
